incident_description: A process technician came into contact with caustic solution during sampling at the chemical storage cabinet. She was not wearing the required chemical-resistant gloves. She was referred to a specialist for an inhalation injury and could not perform normal duties for weeks.

root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the affected area.
immediate_action: Affected area flushed at the eyewash/safety shower and employee sent for medical evaluation.

corrective_action: Repair or replace the damaged component, test the circuit and verify earthing and insulation before re-energising the overhead cable run. Introduce a structured shift handover and job briefing.
preventive_action: Standardise the shift handover format and use toolbox talks to share hazard information. Extend test-before-touch verification to all panel work.

He received first aid for a minor bruising injury to his foot and continued duty; the area was cordoned off after the incident.
root_cause_description: There was no supervisory oversight of the task at the time of the incident.
immediate_action: Vehicle stopped and keys removed; injured employee attended and area barricaded.
corrective_action: Inspect the vehicle, enforce speed limits and improve mirrors, markings and lighting near the despatch area. Reassign supervision coverage for the shift.
preventive_action: Define supervisor span of control and introduce behavioural safety observations.

incident_description: At around 5:44 am, a fabricator hurt himself pushing an overloaded hand tool up the ramp. It was towards the end of a long night shift. A delivery deadline meant the task was done in a hurry. He was taken to the plant medical centre for treatment of a musculoskeletal strain to his back and was placed on light duty.
root_cause_description: Excess workload, long hours or fatigue reduced alertness.
immediate_action: Employee given first aid and relieved from lifting duties for the shift.
corrective_action: Provide lifting aids or trolleys for the task and reorganise storage to avoid heavy lifting from floor level. Rotate shifts and reallocate manpower to reduce overload.
preventive_action: Monitor overtime limits, schedule adequate rest and plan workloads realistically. Provide lifting aids and manual handling refresher training.

incident_description: A carton slid from the upper level of the forklift truck and hit a staff member in the aisle. The supervisor had left the floor before the job was inspected; she was sent for medical treatment of a bruising injury to her foot and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: Inadequate supervision; unsafe practices were not detected or corrected.
immediate_action: Area below the load barricaded, injured worker given first aid and sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Increase supervisory presence and assign responsibility for verifying high-risk jobs.
preventive_action: Define supervisor span of control and introduce behavioural safety observations. Set safe stacking heights and carry out periodic rack inspections.

incident_description: While the night shift was in progress, flammable solvent vapours near the gas scrubber ignited and a flash fire followed. Tools and offcuts were lying around the work area. Nobody was hurt, although the damage stopped work in the area for the rest of the shift.
root_cause_description: Poor housekeeping in the reactor bay allowed materials or spillage to accumulate.
immediate_action: Fire extinguished with portable extinguishers, power isolated and the area evacuated.
corrective_action: Replace damaged equipment, remove combustible residue and check fire detection and suppression near the gas scrubber. Clean up and reorganise the area and assign housekeeping responsibilities.
preventive_action: Schedule daily housekeeping inspections and 5S audits with named area owners. Verify fire detection and hot-work controls in the periodic fire audit.

incident_description: At around 3:30 pm, a packing operator experienced strain while labelling boxes in a fixed position for most of the shift. He had joined the department only a few weeks earlier and had not completed the induction. Earlier warnings about this practice had not been followed up by the section head. A delivery deadline meant the task was done in a hurry; he received first aid for a minor musculoskeletal strain to his wrist and continued duty.
root_cause_description: The employee lacked training or competence for the task and induction was incomplete.
immediate_action: Employee moved to light duties and referred to the occupational health clinic.
corrective_action: Adjust the workstation layout, provide adjustable equipment and introduce task rotation. Complete formal induction and supervised on-the-job training before independent work.
preventive_action: Make induction and refresher training mandatory, with competency sign-off in the training matrix. Conduct ergonomic assessments and task-rotation plans.

incident_description: An utility technician fainted while carrying out routine work in the cooling tower area during the afternoon. No risk assessment had been done for this non-routine job. He sustained a minor case of heat exhaustion and was given first aid at the site before returning to work.
root_cause_description: The hazards were not identified because no adequate risk assessment existed for the task.
immediate_action: Work stopped, employee cooled with wet towels and sent to the clinic.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the cooling tower area. Review the risk assessment and communicate the changes to the team.
preventive_action: Make job hazard analysis mandatory for non-routine tasks and review risk assessments annually.

incident_description: An electrician got an electric shock from a portable tool connected to the HT switchgear panel. He was still learning the job and was working with little guidance. He was referred to a specialist for an electric shock injury and could not perform normal duties for weeks.
root_cause_description: No formal instruction had been given for this activity before the employee was assigned to it.
immediate_action: Circuit de-energised, area secured and the injured employee sent for ECG and medical review.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the damaged component, test the circuit and verify earthing and insulation before re-energising the HT switchgear panel. Provide task-specific training and a competency assessment for the employee.
preventive_action: Make induction and refresher training mandatory, with competency sign-off in the training matrix. Extend test-before-touch verification to all panel work.

incident_description: A team member fainted while carrying out routine work in the motor repair bay during the afternoon. The area was in poor physical condition with damaged fittings; he was taken to the plant medical centre for treatment of a case of heat exhaustion and was placed on light duty
root_cause_description: An unsafe work environment existed in the motor repair bay without controls.
immediate_action: Employee moved to a cool area, given water and monitored; medical team called.

incident_description: At around 4:11 pm, an employee developed persistent pain after repeating the same motion for long periods while sorting parts into bins. corrective_action: Inspect the grinding machine, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Clear the overdue maintenance backlog for the grinding machine and restore its inspection schedule.
preventive_action: Introduce routine equipment inspection and housekeeping checks. Include machine guarding and emergency-stop tests in the periodic audit.

incident_description: During the evening shift, an employee hurt herself pushing an overloaded packing table up the ramp. The temporary staging had loose boards; condensation had formed on the floor because of the humid weather. She was sent for medical treatment of a sprain to her knee and worked restricted duties afterwards. Co-workers stopped the work and helped at the scene.
root_cause_description: An unsafe work environment existed in the packing hall without controls.
immediate_action: Employee given first aid and relieved from lifting duties for the shift.
corrective_action: Provide lifting aids or trolleys for the task and reorganise storage to avoid heavy lifting from floor level. Correct the unsafe condition (barriers, access, ventilation or layout) before work resumes.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe.

incident_description: While opening the cover of the welding machine, the maintenance technician was hit by an electrical flash and suffered burns; the verbal instruction was misunderstood by the other person. The written work instruction was unclear about this step. He needed treatment at a nearby hospital for an electrical burn to his arm and lost working days.
root_cause_description: Information about the hazard or work status was not communicated between people or shifts.
immediate_action: Supply isolated, burns cooled and dressed, and the employee transported to hospital.
corrective_action: Inspect and repair the faulty electrical equipment, verify protective device settings and label the arc-flash boundary. Introduce a structured shift handover and job briefing.
preventive_action: Standardise the shift handover format and use toolbox talks to share hazard information.

incident_description: An employee collapsed while carrying out a task next to the moulding machine in the production line 2. The outside temperature was above 42 degrees Celsius and the area had no cooling. He was sent for medical treatment of a case of heat exhaustion and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: Weather and site conditions were beyond what the existing controls could handle.
immediate_action: Employee moved to a cool area, given water and monitored; medical team called.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the production line 2. Add weather or temperature triggers that stop or modify the work.
preventive_action: Introduce weather and temperature action plans and adapt work schedules to conditions. Implement heat-stress monitoring with work/rest cycles.

incident_description: A blast occurred at the air compressor when pressure built up rapidly during a restart. There is no lifting aid built into the layout for this task. She was admitted to hospital with a serious set of injuries to several parts of the body that needed surgery and a long period of recovery.
root_cause_description: The design of the equipment or work area left the hazard uncontrolled.
immediate_action: Emergency response activated, area evacuated and casualties sent to hospital.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the damaged equipment, inspect all pressure-relief devices and restart only after engineering review. Engage engineering to redesign the affected area.
preventive_action: Include HSE review at the design and modification stage and follow up with periodic guarding and ergonomics reviews. Review process safety, relief devices and pressure test schedules.

incident_description: While the morning shift was in progress, the line supervisor noticed a missing toe board on the platform in the moulding area before stepping onto it. She took a shortcut across the area without noticing what was happening around her. No injury or damage resulted.

immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the affected area. Introduce a pre-task check and buddy verification for this activity.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

immediate_action: Employee given first aid and relieved from lifting duties for the shift.
corrective_action: Provide lifting aids or trolleys for the task and reorganise storage to avoid heavy lifting from floor level. Review the risk assessment and communicate the changes to the team.
preventive_action: Make job hazard analysis mandatory for non-routine tasks and review risk assessments annually. Provide lifting aids and manual handling refresher training.

incident_description: While the evening shift was in progress, sparks came from the HT switchgear panel when the door was opened; an electrical technician moved away in time. The isolation was not verified with a test before she began working. It was reported as a near miss.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the HT switchgear panel.
immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the HT switchgear panel. Reissue the procedure and permit requirements and audit compliance for this task.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

incident_description: In the Assembly Line B, a line supervisor fainted while carrying out routine work in the assembly line b during the afternoon; he was referred to a specialist for a case of heat exhaustion and could not perform normal duties for weeks.
root_cause_description: Weather and site conditions were beyond what the existing controls could handle.
immediate_action: Work stopped, employee cooled with wet towels and sent to the clinic.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the assembly line b. Add weather or temperature triggers that stop or modify the work.
preventive_action: Introduce weather and temperature action plans and adapt work schedules to conditions.

incident_description: The line supervisor was operating the drilling machine when his hand came into contact with a rotating component. The drilling machine did not respond to the controls as expected. He was still learning the job and was working with little guidance. He was sent to hospital with an eye injury and was placed on restricted duty for several weeks.
root_cause_description: Sudden failure of a component of the drilling machine that could not be foreseen from routine checks.
immediate_action: Machine stopped and isolated; injured employee given first aid and sent to the medical centre.
corrective_action: Inspect the drilling machine, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Carry out failure analysis on the component and fit a certified replacement.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Include machine guarding and emergency-stop tests in the periodic audit.

incident_description: During the evening shift, the packing operator slipped on a greasy patch on the walkway while heading to the canteen. Oil had been seeping from the same joint for a long time according to the operators. The equipment was old and showed visible signs of wear. The guarding around the moving parts was partial and loosely fitted. He was treated with first aid for a sprain to his ankle and there was no lost time.
root_cause_description: Inspection and maintenance of the affected area were overdue and known defects had not been rectified.
immediate_action: Injured employee given first aid and area cordoned off; the spill was cleaned with absorbent material.
corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Clear the overdue maintenance backlog for the affected area and restore its inspection schedule.
preventive_action: Adopt a preventive maintenance programme with tracked work orders and periodic inspection audits. Install drip trays and absorbent mats at leak-prone locations.

incident_description: A hissing sound from the distillation column led a chemical operator to find a gas leak at a fitting. The lubrication and inspection schedule for the distillation column had not been followed for some time. The existing risk assessment was outdated and did not reflect the new layout. There were no injuries but the distillation column was damaged and the area was shut for several hours. The shift in-charge reported the incident to the safety officer.
root_cause_description: Inspection and maintenance of the distillation column were overdue and known defects had not been rectified.
immediate_action: Gas supply isolated, area evacuated and ventilated, and gas levels monitored before re-entry.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the leaking joint or valve, pressure test the line and recalibrate the gas detectors. Complete the overdue repairs and update the maintenance records.
preventive_action: Adopt a preventive maintenance programme with tracked work orders and periodic inspection audits. Install fixed gas detection and schedule regular leak surveys.

incident_description: A fire started on a hot surface of the steam boiler where flammable residue had collected.
root_cause_description: Sudden failure of a component of the steam boiler that could not be foreseen from routine checks.
immediate_action: Fire alarm raised, the emergency team responded and the fire was put out; area closed pending inspection.
corrective_action: Replace damaged equipment, remove combustible residue and check fire detection and suppression near the steam boiler. Repair or replace the failed component and verify function tests against the manufacturer's guidelines.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Verify fire detection and hot-work controls in the periodic fire audit.

incident_description: A worker slipped on oil that had collected on the floor beside the moulding machine. He was distracted by a phone call from the control room at that moment.
root_cause_description: A momentary lapse in concentration led to the wrong action being taken at the moulding machine.
immediate_action: Area barricaded with warning signs, floor cleaned and dried, and the injured person sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Introduce a pre-task check and buddy verification for this activity.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Install drip trays and absorbent mats at leak-prone locations.

incident_description: A welder was caught between the moving carriage and the fixed frame of the transfer pump.
root_cause_description: A control or mechanical failure of the transfer pump caused unexpected behaviour.
immediate_action: Machine stopped and isolated, employee released and taken for urgent medical attention.
corrective_action: Fit fixed guarding and interlocks at the nip point of the transfer pump and verify lock-out before any cleaning or clearing. Repair or replace the failed component and verify function tests against the manufacturer's guidelines.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Extend lockout/tagout verification to all cleaning and clearing tasks.

incident_description: A pipe fell from the forklift while it was being lifted and hit a machine operator. The brake failed to hold and the load moved.
root_cause_description: Sudden failure of a component of the forklift that could not be foreseen from routine checks.
immediate_action: Work stopped in the zone and remaining materials secured.
corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Repair or replace the failed component and verify function tests against the manufacturer's guidelines.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Set safe stacking heights and carry out periodic rack inspections.

incident_description: A warehouse associate hurt himself pushing an overloaded powered pallet truck up the ramp. He received first aid for a minor sprain to his neck and continued duty.

immediate_action: Employee given first aid and relieved from lifting duties for the shift.
corrective_action: Provide lifting aids or trolleys for the task and reorganise storage to avoid heavy lifting from floor level. Counsel the employee and brief the team on the correct method for the task.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Provide lifting aids and manual handling refresher training.

incident_description: During cleaning of the injection moulding machine, a worker touched a moving part that was still running. He said he had never been shown how to do this task safely. He received outpatient treatment for a crush injury to his foot and was advised rest.

incident_description: A pressure vessel connected to the reactor vessel exploded during startup and the contractor was thrown back. incident_description: A process technician developed severe cramps, headache and profuse sweating while working in the tank farm. The outside temperature was above 42 degrees Celsius and the area had no cooling. She was taken to the plant medical centre for treatment of a case of heat exhaustion and was placed on light duty.
root_cause_description: Weather and site conditions were beyond what the existing controls could handle.
immediate_action: Employee moved to a cool area, given water and monitored; medical team called.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the tank farm. Provide environmental controls suitable for the conditions and restrict work when conditions are adverse.
preventive_action: Introduce weather and temperature action plans and adapt work schedules to conditions.

preventive_action: Standardise the shift handover format and use toolbox talks to share hazard information. Enforce speed limits and pedestrian segregation, and run forklift refresher assessments.

root_cause_description: The employee lacked training or competence for the task and induction was incomplete.
immediate_action: Emergency stop pressed, power isolated and the injured person taken for medical attention.
corrective_action: Inspect the drilling machine, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Complete formal induction and supervised on-the-job training before independent work.
preventive_action: Make induction and refresher training mandatory, with competency sign-off in the training matrix. Include machine guarding and emergency-stop tests in the periodic audit.

incident_description: The electrician was burned when a flashover happened while she was racking a breaker on the motor. She was not wearing arc-rated clothing or a face shield. She did not know the emergency procedure for this situation. She was sent for medical treatment of an electrical burn to her hand and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: The employee did not use the mandatory PPE for the task.
immediate_action: Area evacuated, power cut at the main breaker and burns dressed by the first aider.

preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions. Conduct arc-flash studies and label equipment with incident energy.

corrective_action: Inspect the vehicle, enforce speed limits and improve mirrors, markings and lighting near the raw material store. Introduce a pre-task check and buddy verification for this activity.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls.

incident_description: In the Paint Booth Area, a welder reached into the bench grinder to remove a jam and pulled his hand out just before the machine cycled. No risk assessment had been done for this non-routine job. The crew was working unsupervised for most of the shift. It was reported as a near miss.
root_cause_description: The hazards were not identified because no adequate risk assessment existed for the task.
immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the bench grinder. Review the risk assessment and communicate the changes to the team.
preventive_action: Make job hazard analysis mandatory for non-routine tasks and review risk assessments annually. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

incident_description: While the morning shift was in progress, a staff member noticed the pressure on the press rising above the normal range and reduced the load before any release. Nobody was overseeing the job even though it was assigned to a junior team member. The hazards of the task had not been identified beforehand. It was reported as a near miss.
root_cause_description: The employee lacked training or competence for the task and induction was incomplete.
immediate_action: Hazard made safe on the spot and the near miss reported to the safety officer.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the press. Provide task-specific training and a competency assessment for the employee.
preventive_action: Make induction and refresher training mandatory, with competency sign-off in the training matrix. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

incident_description: At around 3:49 pm, the helper was using the hand tool when the tool slipped and cut him. The guard was removed while the equipment was still energised. Nobody was overseeing the job even though it was assigned to a junior team member. He was sent to hospital with a fracture to his finger and was placed on restricted duty for several weeks.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the hand tool.
immediate_action: Emergency stop pressed, power isolated and the injured person taken for medical attention.
corrective_action: Inspect the hand tool, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Reinforce adherence to the approved procedure through a toolbox talk and counselling.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management. Include machine guarding and emergency-stop tests in the periodic audit.

incident_description: A loader suffered irritation after handling cleaning chemicals in the despatch area; she did not use face shield for this task even though it was available in the store. She was treated with first aid for a chemical burn to her eye and there was no lost time.
root_cause_description: The employee did not use the mandatory PPE for the task.
immediate_action: Affected area flushed at the eyewash/safety shower and employee sent for medical evaluation.
corrective_action: Review the chemical transfer and handling method at the affected area, replace damaged containers or PPE and test eyewash/shower stations. Replace worn or unsuitable PPE and reinforce its mandatory use.
preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions. Ensure safety data sheets are available and run chemical handling refreshers.

incident_description: A reach truck struck a worker while reversing in the finished goods store. Maintenance records showed the reach truck was overdue for servicing. Nobody had assessed what could go wrong before the work began. He received first aid for a minor sprain to his knee and continued duty.
root_cause_description: Lack of preventive maintenance led to deterioration of the reach truck.
immediate_action: Traffic in the area halted, injured worker given first aid and the vehicle taken out of service pending checks.
corrective_action: Inspect the vehicle, enforce speed limits and improve mirrors, markings and lighting near the finished goods store. Complete the overdue repairs and update the maintenance records.
preventive_action: Adopt a preventive maintenance programme with tracked work orders and periodic inspection audits. Enforce speed limits and pedestrian segregation, and run forklift refresher assessments.

incident_description: Smoke was seen coming from the grinding machine; a machine operator switched it off and put out a small flame. The emergency stop did not respond when pressed. No injury or damage resulted.
root_cause_description: A control or mechanical failure of the grinding machine caused unexpected behaviour.
immediate_action: Hazard made safe on the spot and the near miss reported to the safety officer.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the grinding machine. Carry out failure analysis on the component and fit a certified replacement.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

incident_description: A production technician received a small cut from the grinding machine while opening cartons. The exact sequence of events could not be established from the initial report. Unsafe practices in this section had been tolerated for some time. She was sent for medical treatment of a bruising injury to her head and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: Multiple minor factors combined and no single dominant cause was identified.
immediate_action: First aid given and the area inspected.
corrective_action: Inspect and rectify the identified condition and record the outcome. Review the circumstances, record lessons learned and apply any relevant control.
preventive_action: Encourage incident and near-miss reporting to identify emerging patterns. Review the incident at the monthly safety committee.

incident_description: A carboy of acid fell from the trolley in the blending area and broke, spilling its contents. The job hazard analysis did not cover the task being done. No warning sign or barricade had been placed around the area. No one was hurt; damage was limited and work resumed shortly.
root_cause_description: The risk assessment did not cover the task or was out of date.
immediate_action: Leak stopped at source, area ventilated and cordoned off, and the spill cleaned by the trained team.
corrective_action: Replace the failed hose, valve or container, clean the spill area and dispose of contaminated waste properly. Conduct a full job hazard analysis for the task and update the controls.
preventive_action: Make job hazard analysis mandatory for non-routine tasks and review risk assessments annually.

incident_description: A pressure vessel connected to the steam boiler exploded during startup and an utility operator was thrown back. He had not been told that the line had been restarted. No supervisor was present in the area at the time. There were no injuries; the damage to the steam boiler was significant and the section was shut down for days.
root_cause_description: A breakdown in communication left the employee unaware of the hazard.
immediate_action: Plant section shut down, utilities isolated and casualties given first aid by the emergency team.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the damaged equipment, inspect all pressure-relief devices and restart only after engineering review. Clarify communication channels and require verbal confirmation before starting the job.
preventive_action: Standardise the shift handover format and use toolbox talks to share hazard information.

incident_description: The quality inspector was caught between the moving carriage and the fixed frame of the drilling machine. The guard had been opened and the machine was not isolated. She was sent for medical treatment of a crush injury to her arm and worked restricted duties afterwards.

immediate_action: Emergency stop pressed, power isolated and first aid provided before transfer to hospital.
corrective_action: Fit fixed guarding and interlocks at the nip point of the drilling machine and verify lock-out before any cleaning or clearing. Reinforce adherence to the approved procedure through a toolbox talk and counselling.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management.

incident_description: At around 3:51 pm, a maintenance technician did not see a step at the edge of the motor repair bay in the poor light and fell. corrective_action: Remove the tripping hazard, re-mark the walkways and restore an even floor surface. Fix the identified physical hazards and block access to the area until then.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe. Mark and maintain designated walkways and cable routes.

preventive_action: Introduce routine equipment inspection and housekeeping checks.

incident_description: The security guard was stung by a wasp near the parking area while doing a routine check. She had worked a double shift due to staff shortage.
root_cause_description: Excess workload, long hours or fatigue reduced alertness.
immediate_action: Employee attended by the first aider and the incident reported to the supervisor.
corrective_action: Inspect and rectify the identified condition and record the outcome. Review staffing and overtime and adjust workloads and rest breaks for the team.
preventive_action: Monitor overtime limits, schedule adequate rest and plan workloads realistically. Review the incident at the monthly safety committee.

incident_description: A forklift operator caught his foot on an empty pallet left in the aisle of the despatch area and fell forward. A hose and several empty pallets had been left in the walkway. He received first aid for a minor sprain to his knee and continued duty.
root_cause_description: Housekeeping responsibilities for the despatch area were not being followed.
immediate_action: Area cleared of obstructions and the injured employee escorted to the clinic.
corrective_action: Remove the tripping hazard, re-mark the walkways and restore an even floor surface. Remove clutter and restore designated storage and walkways.
preventive_action: Schedule daily housekeeping inspections and 5S audits with named area owners.

incident_description: The contractor received a shock from the metal casing of the MCC panel while holding it. No permit to work had been issued and the circuit was not tested dead. The supervisor had left the floor before the job was inspected. He was referred to a specialist for an electric shock injury to his arm and could not perform normal duties for weeks.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the MCC panel.
immediate_action: Circuit de-energised, area secured and the injured employee sent for ECG and medical review.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the damaged component, test the circuit and verify earthing and insulation before re-energising the MCC panel. Reinforce adherence to the approved procedure through a toolbox talk and counselling.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management. Extend test-before-touch verification to all panel work.

incident_description: While the morning shift was in progress, loose tools left on a ledge fell and struck a warehouse associate in the raw material store. Loose tools were left at the edge of the platform. He sustained a minor bruising injury to his shoulder and was given first aid at the site before returning to work.
root_cause_description: Poor housekeeping in the raw material store allowed materials or spillage to accumulate.

corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Remove clutter and restore designated storage and walkways.
preventive_action: Schedule daily housekeeping inspections and 5S audits with named area owners. Set safe stacking heights and carry out periodic rack inspections.

incident_description: A routine audiometry test showed a threshold shift for an electrician who works close to the DG set. He said he had forgotten to put on ear muffs; he received outpatient treatment for a hearing impairment and was advised rest.

corrective_action: Fit noise dampening or an enclosure to reduce noise at the DG set and provide suitable hearing protection. Issue suitable PPE and enforce its use through supervisor checks.
preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions. Conduct periodic noise surveys and audiometric testing.

incident_description: A lab technician came into contact with caustic solution during sampling at the fume hood. He said he had forgotten to put on face shield. corrective_action: Review the chemical transfer and handling method at the fume hood, replace damaged containers or PPE and test eyewash/shower stations. Issue suitable PPE and enforce its use through supervisor checks.
preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions. Ensure safety data sheets are available and run chemical handling refreshers.

He was referred to a specialist for an eye injury and could not perform normal duties for weeks.
root_cause_description: Inspection and maintenance of the plasma cutter were overdue and known defects had not been rectified.
immediate_action: Area evacuated, power cut at the main breaker and burns dressed by the first aider.
corrective_action: Inspect and repair the faulty electrical equipment, verify protective device settings and label the arc-flash boundary. Clear the overdue maintenance backlog for the plasma cutter and restore its inspection schedule.
preventive_action: Introduce routine equipment inspection and housekeeping checks.

The area was laid out with no separation between pedestrians and moving equipment. The barrier around the hazard was incomplete. Nobody was hurt.

corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the bench grinder. Engage engineering to redesign the affected area.
preventive_action: Include HSE review at the design and modification stage and follow up with periodic guarding and ergonomics reviews.

She was sent to hospital with a hernia in the abdomen and was placed on restricted duty for several weeks.
root_cause_description: A design weakness in the hand tools exposed the employee to the hazard.
immediate_action: Task stopped and the injured person sent for medical assessment.
corrective_action: Provide lifting aids or trolleys for the task and reorganise storage to avoid heavy lifting from floor level. Engage engineering to redesign the affected area.
preventive_action: Include HSE review at the design and modification stage and follow up with periodic guarding and ergonomics reviews.

incident_description: During the night shift, a machine operator was carrying a component to the grinding machine when he slipped on lubricant on the floor and went down heavily. He was wearing ordinary shoes instead of slip-resistant safety footwear. He was sent for medical treatment of a sprain to his wrist and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: Required PPE was available but not worn; enforcement lapses were noted.
immediate_action: Injured employee given first aid and area cordoned off; the spill was cleaned with absorbent material.
corrective_action: Clean the affected floor, repair the source of leakage or spillage at the grinding machine and restore a slip-resistant surface. Issue suitable PPE and enforce its use through supervisor checks.
preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions.

incident_description: At around 3:39 am, a routine audiometry test showed a threshold shift for the mechanical fitter who works close to the bench grinder. A sensor fault caused an unexpected movement. Cable insulation and fittings in the area were cracked and ageing. He sustained a minor hearing impairment and was given first aid at the site before returning to work. The incident was entered into the reporting system by the section head.
root_cause_description: Sudden failure of a component of the bench grinder that could not be foreseen from routine checks.
immediate_action: Employee removed from the noisy area and referred for audiometric testing.
corrective_action: Fit noise dampening or an enclosure to reduce noise at the bench grinder and provide suitable hearing protection. Carry out failure analysis on the component and fit a certified replacement.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Conduct periodic noise surveys and audiometric testing.

incident_description: A tool slipped off the mezzanine edge and landed in the walkway below where nobody was standing. He misjudged the clearance and moved before the motion had finished. There was general clutter and material left where it should not have been; it was reported as a near miss.
root_cause_description: Error in execution during a routine activity; no deliberate violation identified.
immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the affected area. Counsel the employee and brief the team on the correct method for the task.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls.

incident_description: A load slipped from the forklift truck and dropped onto a line supervisor who was standing below.
root_cause_description: There was no supervisory oversight of the task at the time of the incident.
immediate_action: Area below the load barricaded, injured worker given first aid and sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Increase supervisory presence and assign responsibility for verifying high-risk jobs.
preventive_action: Define supervisor span of control and introduce behavioural safety observations. Set safe stacking heights and carry out periodic rack inspections.

incident_description: In the Plant Floor, a bolt fell from a worker's tool bag on the mezzanine and struck the electrician below. The safety interlock had been bridged so that work could continue. root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the affected area.
immediate_action: Work stopped in the zone and remaining materials secured.

incident_description: After working for several hours in the cooling tower area, a boiler operator became confused and stopped sweating. The work area was congested and there was no clear escape route; the hazards of the task had not been identified beforehand. He needed treatment at a nearby hospital for a case of heat stroke and lost working days.
root_cause_description: The physical condition of the work area (access, barriers or layout) was unsafe and had not been corrected.
immediate_action: Employee moved to a cool area, given water and monitored; medical team called.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the cooling tower area. Fix the identified physical hazards and block access to the area until then.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe. Implement heat-stress monitoring with work/rest cycles.

corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Clean up and reorganise the area and assign housekeeping responsibilities.
preventive_action: Schedule daily housekeeping inspections and 5S audits with named area owners.

incident_description: A maintenance technician suffered irritation after handling cleaning chemicals in the motor repair bay. He had not been shown the safe way of doing the task. The roof and drainage had been leaking for months and repairs were still pending. He received first aid for a minor skin irritation to his arm and continued duty.
root_cause_description: The employee lacked training or competence for the task and induction was incomplete.
immediate_action: Affected area flushed at the eyewash/safety shower and employee sent for medical evaluation.
corrective_action: Review the chemical transfer and handling method at the affected area, replace damaged containers or PPE and test eyewash/shower stations. Provide task-specific training and a competency assessment for the employee.
preventive_action: Make induction and refresher training mandatory, with competency sign-off in the training matrix.

incident_description: During the evening shift, a load slipped from the forklift truck and dropped onto the packing operator who was standing below. The job hazard analysis did not cover the task being done. The instructions given for the task were ambiguous. She sustained a minor bruising injury to her back and was given first aid at the site before returning to work.
root_cause_description: The risk assessment did not cover the task or was out of date.
immediate_action: Area below the load barricaded, injured worker given first aid and sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Conduct a full job hazard analysis for the task and update the controls.
preventive_action: Make job hazard analysis mandatory for non-routine tasks and review risk assessments annually.

incident_description: In the Admin Block, an employee walking through the admin block slipped on scattered metal shavings and fell. A mop bucket and loose packaging had been left in the walkway and the floor was still wet. He was sent to hospital with a dislocation to his shoulder and was placed on restricted duty for several weeks. The area was cordoned off after the incident.
root_cause_description: Poor housekeeping in the admin block allowed materials or spillage to accumulate.
immediate_action: Area barricaded with warning signs, floor cleaned and dried, and the injured person sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Clean up and reorganise the area and assign housekeeping responsibilities.
preventive_action: Schedule daily housekeeping inspections and 5S audits with named area owners. Install drip trays and absorbent mats at leak-prone locations.

incident_description: During the night shift, a pipe fell from the overhead crane while it was being lifted and hit the maintenance technician. The load was stacked above the permitted height. No supervisor was present in the area at the time. He was referred to a specialist for a head injury and could not perform normal duties for weeks.
root_cause_description: A safety rule was bypassed to save time; required permits and checks were not completed.
immediate_action: Work stopped in the zone and remaining materials secured.
corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Reissue the procedure and permit requirements and audit compliance for this task.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management. Set safe stacking heights and carry out periodic rack inspections.

incident_description: The electrician slipped on a ramp in the MCC Room in the poor visibility and fell. Condensation had formed on the floor because of the high humidity. He was taken to the plant medical centre for treatment of a bruising injury to his hip and was placed on light duty.
root_cause_description: Weather and site conditions were beyond what the existing controls could handle.
immediate_action: Area barricaded with warning signs, floor cleaned and dried, and the injured person sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Add weather or temperature triggers that stop or modify the work.
preventive_action: Introduce weather and temperature action plans and adapt work schedules to conditions. Install drip trays and absorbent mats at leak-prone locations.

incident_description: Solvent splashed on a worker while he was topping up the transfer line. He was not wearing the required face shield. He was sent for medical treatment of a skin irritation to his hand and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: The employee did not use the mandatory PPE for the task.
immediate_action: Employee moved to fresh air, contaminated clothing removed and medical help called.
corrective_action: Review the chemical transfer and handling method at the transfer line, replace damaged containers or PPE and test eyewash/shower stations. Issue suitable PPE and enforce its use through supervisor checks.
preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions.

incident_description: The machine operator was struck by a piece of material that flew off the conveyor during operation. He was not told that maintenance work was in progress on the conveyor. The team leader was away from the section and nobody checked the work. He received first aid for a minor bruising injury to his shoulder and continued duty. The shift in-charge reported the incident to the safety officer.
root_cause_description: A breakdown in communication left the employee unaware of the hazard.
immediate_action: Area secured and injured employee sent to the clinic; the object removed.
corrective_action: Secure loose material, install a barrier around the hazard zone and mark exclusion areas. Clarify communication channels and require verbal confirmation before starting the job.
preventive_action: Standardise the shift handover format and use toolbox talks to share hazard information. Establish exclusion zones and control line-of-fire hazards.

incident_description: A mechanical fitter fell after stepping on a section of the floor in the motor repair bay that had just been washed.
root_cause_description: An unsafe work environment existed in the motor repair bay without controls.
immediate_action: Area barricaded with warning signs, floor cleaned and dried, and the injured person sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Correct the unsafe condition (barriers, access, ventilation or layout) before work resumes.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe.

corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Complete formal induction and supervised on-the-job training before independent work.
preventive_action: Make induction and refresher training mandatory, with competency sign-off in the training matrix.

incident_description: A fabricator reported ringing in the ears after a shift near the bench grinder; area readings were high. The bench grinder developed a sudden fault during normal operation. She received first aid for a minor hearing impairment and continued duty.

immediate_action: Area marked as a high-noise zone and hearing protection issued on the spot.
corrective_action: Fit noise dampening or an enclosure to reduce noise at the bench grinder and provide suitable hearing protection. Carry out failure analysis on the component and fit a certified replacement.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Conduct periodic noise surveys and audiometric testing.

incident_description: A production technician was knocked down by a forklift truck at the crossing between the production line 1 and the yard. The guarding did not cover the full pinch point, leaving a gap. The barrier around the hazard was incomplete. She was referred to a specialist for a fracture to her hip and could not perform normal duties for weeks. The safety team visited the area shortly afterwards
root_cause_description: The design of the equipment or work area left the hazard uncontrolled.
immediate_action: Traffic in the area halted, injured worker given first aid and the vehicle taken out of service pending checks.
corrective_action: Inspect the vehicle, enforce speed limits and improve mirrors, markings and lighting near the production line 1. Engage engineering to redesign the affected area.
preventive_action: Include HSE review at the design and modification stage and follow up with periodic guarding and ergonomics reviews. Enforce speed limits and pedestrian segregation, and run forklift refresher assessments.

incident_description: A production technician reported ringing in the ears after a shift near the CNC lathe; area readings were high. He was not wearing ear protection.

corrective_action: Fit noise dampening or an enclosure to reduce noise at the CNC lathe and provide suitable hearing protection. Issue suitable PPE and enforce its use through supervisor checks.
preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions.

incident_description: In the Substation, a shock was received by an electrical technician while pulling a cable through the motor in the substation. It appears she pressed the wrong switch during the routine task. She said she had never been shown how to do this task safely. She received outpatient treatment for an electrical burn to her arm and was advised rest. Co-workers stopped the work and helped at the scene.
root_cause_description: Employee misjudged the task and did not check before acting, indicating a lapse in attention during electrical shock.
immediate_action: Power supply isolated immediately; casualty checked by the plant medical team.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the damaged component, test the circuit and verify earthing and insulation before re-energising the motor. Counsel the employee and brief the team on the correct method for the task.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Extend test-before-touch verification to all panel work.

incident_description: At around 11:19 pm, a hissing sound from the press led a mechanical fitter to find a gas leak at a fitting. root_cause_description: The employee lacked training or competence for the task and induction was incomplete.
immediate_action: Alarm raised, affected personnel moved to the assembly point and the leak source isolated.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the leaking joint or valve, pressure test the line and recalibrate the gas detectors. Complete formal induction and supervised on-the-job training before independent work.
preventive_action: Make induction and refresher training mandatory, with competency sign-off in the training matrix.

incident_description: An employee got an electric shock from a portable tool connected to the motor. He was sent for medical treatment of an electric shock injury to his arm and worked restricted duties afterwards.

corrective_action: Repair or replace the damaged component, test the circuit and verify earthing and insulation before re-energising the motor. Clarify communication channels and require verbal confirmation before starting the job.
preventive_action: Standardise the shift handover format and use toolbox talks to share hazard information.

incident_description: An employee experienced strain while clearing scrap in a fixed position for most of the shift. He had been doing the same repetitive task for long hours without rotation. immediate_action: Employee moved to light duties and referred to the occupational health clinic.
corrective_action: Adjust the workstation layout, provide adjustable equipment and introduce task rotation. Rotate shifts and reallocate manpower to reduce overload.
preventive_action: Monitor overtime limits, schedule adequate rest and plan workloads realistically. Conduct ergonomic assessments and task-rotation plans.

incident_description: While cleaning the roller conveyor, the production helper's glove was caught by a rotating shaft and he was pulled in. He was sent to hospital with a fracture to his arm and was placed on restricted duty for several weeks.

preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management. Extend lockout/tagout verification to all cleaning and clearing tasks.

incident_description: A housekeeping staff noticed the pressure on the pressure washer rising above the normal range and reduced the load before any release. The existing risk assessment was outdated and did not reflect the new layout. No injury or damage resulted.

He was referred to a specialist for a sprain to his back and could not perform normal duties for weeks.

immediate_action: Employee given first aid and relieved from lifting duties for the shift.
corrective_action: Provide lifting aids or trolleys for the task and reorganise storage to avoid heavy lifting from floor level. Reassign supervision coverage for the shift.
preventive_action: Define supervisor span of control and introduce behavioural safety observations. Provide lifting aids and manual handling refresher training.

incident_description: During the morning shift, an employee reported pain and numbness after weeks of repetitive work involving the hand tool. He had been doing the same repetitive task for long hours without rotation. Nobody was overseeing the job even though it was assigned to a junior team member. He received first aid for a minor musculoskeletal strain to his elbow and continued duty
root_cause_description: Excess workload, long hours or fatigue reduced alertness.
immediate_action: Employee moved to light duties and referred to the occupational health clinic.
corrective_action: Adjust the workstation layout, provide adjustable equipment and introduce task rotation. Review staffing and overtime and adjust workloads and rest breaks for the team.
preventive_action: Monitor overtime limits, schedule adequate rest and plan workloads realistically.

incident_description: During the morning shift, a machine operator complained of muffled hearing after several days of work beside the compressor. An earlier work order for the same defect was still open. He was sent for medical treatment of a hearing impairment and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: Lack of preventive maintenance led to deterioration of the compressor.
immediate_action: Employee removed from the noisy area and referred for audiometric testing.
corrective_action: Fit noise dampening or an enclosure to reduce noise at the compressor and provide suitable hearing protection. Complete the overdue repairs and update the maintenance records.
preventive_action: Adopt a preventive maintenance programme with tracked work orders and periodic inspection audits. Conduct periodic noise surveys and audiometric testing.

incident_description: In the DG Room, a worker developed ear pain and ringing after a sudden loud release in the DG Room. The guard was removed while the equipment was still energised. He received first aid for a minor hearing impairment and continued duty.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the affected area.
immediate_action: Area marked as a high-noise zone and hearing protection issued on the spot.
corrective_action: Fit noise dampening or an enclosure to reduce noise at the affected area and provide suitable hearing protection. Reinforce adherence to the approved procedure through a toolbox talk and counselling.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management.

incident_description: During the night shift, the forklift truck hit a parked vehicle at the dock and a nearby employee was injured. The blind corner has no mirror and the aisle is too narrow. She was sent for medical treatment of a sprain to her back and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: An unsafe work environment existed in the paint booth area without controls.
immediate_action: Vehicle stopped and keys removed; injured employee attended and area barricaded.
corrective_action: Inspect the vehicle, enforce speed limits and improve mirrors, markings and lighting near the paint booth area. Correct the unsafe condition (barriers, access, ventilation or layout) before work resumes.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe. Enforce speed limits and pedestrian segregation, and run forklift refresher assessments.

incident_description: At around 7:11 am, a worker suffered irritation after handling cleaning chemicals in the tank farm. The area had not been cleaned for several days and materials were scattered around. He received first aid for a minor skin irritation to his hand and continued duty. immediate_action: Work stopped in the zone and remaining materials secured.
corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Conduct a full job hazard analysis for the task and update the controls.
preventive_action: Make job hazard analysis mandatory for non-routine tasks and review risk assessments annually. Set safe stacking heights and carry out periodic rack inspections.

incident_description: A hissing sound from the process pipeline led the chemical operator to find a gas leak at a fitting. A sensor fault caused an unexpected movement. The barrier around the hazard was incomplete. She was sent to hospital with an inhalation injury and was placed on restricted duty for several weeks.
root_cause_description: A control or mechanical failure of the process pipeline caused unexpected behaviour.
immediate_action: Alarm raised, affected personnel moved to the assembly point and the leak source isolated.
corrective_action: Repair or replace the leaking joint or valve, pressure test the line and recalibrate the gas detectors. Carry out failure analysis on the component and fit a certified replacement.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Install fixed gas detection and schedule regular leak surveys.

incident_description: During the night shift, a fire broke out in the bench grinder in the motor repair bay; a contractor tried to put it out with an extinguisher. A short circuit in the wiring started the flames. She received outpatient treatment for an inhalation injury and was advised rest.

immediate_action: Fire alarm raised, the emergency team responded and the fire was put out; area closed pending inspection.
corrective_action: Replace damaged equipment, remove combustible residue and check fire detection and suppression near the bench grinder. Repair or replace the failed component and verify function tests against the manufacturer's guidelines.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Verify fire detection and hot-work controls in the periodic fire audit.

She did not know the emergency procedure for this situation; the injury was severe: she suffered a crush injury to her finger and was admitted to hospital for an extended stay.
root_cause_description: Employee misjudged the task and did not check before acting, indicating a lapse in attention during caught in/between.
immediate_action: Machine stopped and isolated, employee released and taken for urgent medical attention.
corrective_action: Fit fixed guarding and interlocks at the nip point of the robot cell and verify lock-out before any cleaning or clearing. Counsel the employee and brief the team on the correct method for the task.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Extend lockout/tagout verification to all cleaning and clearing tasks.

preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Provide lifting aids and manual handling refresher training.

root_cause_description: The physical condition of the work area (access, barriers or layout) was unsafe and had not been corrected.
immediate_action: Employee moved to a cool area, given water and monitored; medical team called.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the DG Room. Correct the unsafe condition (barriers, access, ventilation or layout) before work resumes.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe. Implement heat-stress monitoring with work/rest cycles.

incident_description: A welder was hit by a jet of compressed air from the oxy-fuel torch while carrying out a routine task. The controller gave a spurious signal and the equipment started on its own. He was taken to the plant medical centre for treatment of a bruising injury to his hand and was placed on light duty.
root_cause_description: Sudden failure of a component of the oxy-fuel torch that could not be foreseen from routine checks.
immediate_action: Emergency stop pressed, power isolated and the injured person taken for medical attention.
corrective_action: Inspect the oxy-fuel torch, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Repair or replace the failed component and verify function tests against the manufacturer's guidelines.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment.

She was treated with first aid for a bruising injury to her hand and there was no lost time.

Nobody was overseeing the job even though it was assigned to a junior team member; he received first aid for a minor hearing impairment and continued duty. The safety team visited the area shortly afterwards.

The incident was entered into the reporting system by the section head.
root_cause_description: Adverse environmental conditions exceeded the existing controls.
immediate_action: Injured employee given first aid and area cordoned off; the spill was cleaned with absorbent material.
corrective_action: Clean the affected floor, repair the source of leakage or spillage at the affected area and restore a slip-resistant surface. Add weather or temperature triggers that stop or modify the work.
preventive_action: Introduce weather and temperature action plans and adapt work schedules to conditions. Install drip trays and absorbent mats at leak-prone locations.

incident_description: A forklift operator developed severe cramps, headache and profuse sweating while working in the raw material store. Nobody had assessed what could go wrong before the work began.

immediate_action: Employee moved to a cool area, given water and monitored; medical team called.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the raw material store. Conduct a full job hazard analysis for the task and update the controls.
preventive_action: Make job hazard analysis mandatory for non-routine tasks and review risk assessments annually. Implement heat-stress monitoring with work/rest cycles.
