He received first aid for a minor sprain to his wrist and continued duty. The supervisor was informed immediately.
root_cause_description: Poor housekeeping in the quality laboratory allowed materials or spillage to accumulate.
immediate_action: Injured employee given first aid and area cordoned off; the spill was cleaned with absorbent material.
corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Clean up and reorganise the area and assign housekeeping responsibilities.
preventive_action: Schedule daily housekeeping inspections and 5S audits with named area owners. Install drip trays and absorbent mats at leak-prone locations.

incident_description: During the morning shift, a mechanical fitter complained of muffled hearing after several days of work beside the press. He had removed his ear muffs earlier because it was uncomfortable. The weather that day was very hot and there was no relief from the sun. No supervisor was present in the area at the time. He received first aid for a minor hearing impairment and continued duty.
root_cause_description: The employee did not use the mandatory PPE for the task.
immediate_action: Area marked as a high-noise zone and hearing protection issued on the spot.
corrective_action: Fit noise dampening or an enclosure to reduce noise at the press and provide suitable hearing protection. Issue suitable PPE and enforce its use through supervisor checks.
preventive_action: Set up PPE compliance audits, stock availability checks and refresher awareness sessions. Conduct periodic noise surveys and audiometric testing.

incident_description: A lab technician experienced strain while running a tensile test in a fixed position for most of the shift.
root_cause_description: Employee misjudged the task and did not check before acting, indicating a lapse in attention during ergonomic injury.
immediate_action: Employee moved to light duties and referred to the occupational health clinic.
corrective_action: Adjust the workstation layout, provide adjustable equipment and introduce task rotation. Introduce a pre-task check and buddy verification for this activity.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Conduct ergonomic assessments and task-rotation plans.

incident_description: While setting up the press brake, a welder slipped on a greasy patch beside the base and fell. Maintenance records showed the press brake was overdue for servicing. He was admitted to hospital with a serious fracture to his ankle that needed surgery and a long period of recovery.
root_cause_description: Lack of preventive maintenance led to deterioration of the press brake.
immediate_action: Area barricaded with warning signs, floor cleaned and dried, and the injured person sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Clean and dry the floor, mark the wet area and fix the defect that allowed liquid onto the walkway. Complete the overdue repairs and update the maintenance records.
preventive_action: Introduce routine equipment inspection and housekeeping checks. Install drip trays and absorbent mats at leak-prone locations.

incident_description: During the morning shift, a guard on the conveyor came loose during operation and landed close to the quality inspector. He ignored the instruction to wait for clearance before starting. The instructions given for the task were ambiguous. Nobody was hurt.
root_cause_description: A safety rule was bypassed to save time; required permits and checks were not completed.
immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the conveyor. Reissue the procedure and permit requirements and audit compliance for this task.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management.

incident_description: A helper fainted while carrying out routine work in the maintenance workshop during the afternoon. The permit to work had not been obtained before the job was started. He was in critical condition on arrival at the hospital with a case of heat stroke.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the affected area.
immediate_action: Work stopped, employee cooled with wet towels and sent to the clinic.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the maintenance workshop. Reissue the procedure and permit requirements and audit compliance for this task.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management. Implement heat-stress monitoring with work/rest cycles.

incident_description: The contractor was operating the grinding machine when his hand came into contact with a rotating component. An earlier work order for the same defect was still open.
root_cause_description: Lack of preventive maintenance led to deterioration of the grinding machine.
immediate_action: Emergency stop pressed, power isolated and the injured person taken for medical attention.
corrective_action: Inspect the grinding machine, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Clear the overdue maintenance backlog for the grinding machine and restore its inspection schedule.
preventive_action: Introduce routine equipment inspection and housekeeping checks. Include machine guarding and emergency-stop tests in the periodic audit.

incident_description: After working for several hours in the press shop, the production technician became confused and stopped sweating. Condensation had formed on the floor because of the humid weather. She had worked a double shift due to staff shortage. She suffered a serious case of heat exhaustion requiring surgery and will be away from work for months.
root_cause_description: Adverse environmental conditions exceeded the existing controls.
immediate_action: Work stopped, employee cooled with wet towels and sent to the clinic.
corrective_action: Provide cooling arrangements, shaded rest areas and drinking water points in the press shop. Add weather or temperature triggers that stop or modify the work.
preventive_action: Introduce weather and temperature action plans and adapt work schedules to conditions. Implement heat-stress monitoring with work/rest cycles.

incident_description: In the Yard, a helper noticed a missing toe board on the platform in the yard before stepping onto it. The task was routine and she carried on without pausing to check the position. She had joined the department only a few weeks earlier and had not completed the induction. Fortunately there were no injuries.
root_cause_description: Error in execution during a routine activity; no deliberate violation identified.
immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the affected area. Introduce a pre-task check and buddy verification for this activity.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

incident_description: The gas monitor alarmed as a maintenance supervisor was about to enter the tank for inspection and she withdrew. She rushed the last step of the job and made an error in the sequence. Manpower was short and she was covering two positions. No injury or damage resulted.
root_cause_description: Employee misjudged the task and did not check before acting, indicating a lapse in attention during near miss.
immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the affected area. Counsel the employee and brief the team on the correct method for the task.
preventive_action: Use pre-task checklists, human-factors awareness sessions and clear visual controls. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

incident_description: A reach truck struck the warehouse associate while reversing in the despatch area. No supervisor was present in the area at the time. He suffered a serious set of injuries to several parts of the body requiring surgery and will be away from work for months.
root_cause_description: Staff shortage and extended working hours led to fatigue.
immediate_action: Traffic in the area halted, injured worker given first aid and the vehicle taken out of service pending checks.
corrective_action: Inspect the vehicle, enforce speed limits and improve mirrors, markings and lighting near the despatch area. Review staffing and overtime and adjust workloads and rest breaks for the team.
preventive_action: Monitor overtime limits, schedule adequate rest and plan workloads realistically. Enforce speed limits and pedestrian segregation, and run forklift refresher assessments.

incident_description: In the Loading Dock, a forklift struck the warehouse associate while reversing in the loading dock. The access route was obstructed by fixed equipment and gave little room to move. She was sent for medical treatment of a sprain to her ankle and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: An unsafe work environment existed in the loading dock without controls.
immediate_action: Traffic in the area halted, injured worker given first aid and the vehicle taken out of service pending checks.
corrective_action: Inspect the vehicle, enforce speed limits and improve mirrors, markings and lighting near the loading dock. Correct the unsafe condition (barriers, access, ventilation or layout) before work resumes.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe. Enforce speed limits and pedestrian segregation, and run forklift refresher assessments.

incident_description: The gas monitor alarmed as a lab technician was about to enter the tank for inspection and she withdrew. The safety interlock had been bridged so that work could continue. Earlier warnings about this practice had not been followed up by the section head. Nobody was hurt.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the affected area.
immediate_action: Work stopped, area secured and the supervisor informed.
corrective_action: Correct the unsafe condition identified and confirm it is safe before work resumes at the affected area. Reinforce adherence to the approved procedure through a toolbox talk and counselling.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management. Encourage near-miss reporting and review the trends monthly.

incident_description: A team member was hit by a jet of compressed air from the moulding machine while carrying out a routine task. The guard interlock on the moulding machine had been damaged for some time and its repair was still pending. Cable insulation and fittings in the area were cracked and ageing; the existing risk assessment was outdated and did not reflect the new layout. She sustained a minor laceration to her hand and was given first aid at the site before returning to work.
root_cause_description: Inspection and maintenance of the moulding machine were overdue and known defects had not been rectified.
immediate_action: Emergency stop pressed, power isolated and the injured person taken for medical attention.
corrective_action: Inspect the moulding machine, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Complete the overdue repairs and update the maintenance records.
preventive_action: Adopt a preventive maintenance programme with tracked work orders and periodic inspection audits. Include machine guarding and emergency-stop tests in the periodic audit.

incident_description: At around 4:10 pm, an utility operator was hit by a jet of compressed air from the compressor while carrying out a routine task. The guard had been removed and the machine was left running while he cleaned it; he was sent for medical treatment of a laceration to his finger and worked restricted duties afterwards.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the compressor.
immediate_action: Emergency stop pressed, power isolated and the injured person taken for medical attention.
corrective_action: Inspect the compressor, repair or replace damaged components and verify guards and emergency stops before restart. Reissue the procedure and permit requirements and audit compliance for this task.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management.

incident_description: Loose tools left on a ledge fell and struck a staff member in the loading dock. The materials on the upper level were stacked unevenly with no retaining barrier.
root_cause_description: An unsafe work environment existed in the loading dock without controls.
immediate_action: Area below the load barricaded, injured worker given first aid and sent for a medical check.
corrective_action: Re-stack or secure the materials, inspect the storage or lifting arrangement and install toe boards or nets where needed. Correct the unsafe condition (barriers, access, ventilation or layout) before work resumes.
preventive_action: Perform regular workplace inspections and close hazard reports within a fixed timeframe.

incident_description: The DB panel sparked and a fire started in its enclosure while an electrician was nearby. A short circuit in the wiring started the flames. The equipment was old and showed visible signs of wear. There were no injuries; the damage to the DB panel was significant and the section was shut down for days. The incident was entered into the reporting system by the section head.
root_cause_description: A control or mechanical failure of the DB panel caused unexpected behaviour.
immediate_action: Fire extinguished with portable extinguishers, power isolated and the area evacuated.
corrective_action: Replace damaged equipment, remove combustible residue and check fire detection and suppression near the DB panel. Repair or replace the failed component and verify function tests against the manufacturer's guidelines.
preventive_action: Introduce condition monitoring and critical-spares control for key equipment. Verify fire detection and hot-work controls in the periodic fire audit.

incident_description: Flames were noticed coming from the gas cutting torch and the helper raised the alarm. Hot work was being done without a permit and without a fire watch. Nobody was hurt, although the damage stopped work in the area for the rest of the shift.
root_cause_description: The established procedure (isolation, permit or SOP) was not followed for the task at the gas cutting torch.
immediate_action: Fire extinguished with portable extinguishers, power isolated and the area evacuated.
corrective_action: Replace damaged equipment, remove combustible residue and check fire detection and suppression near the gas cutting torch. Reinforce adherence to the approved procedure through a toolbox talk and counselling.
preventive_action: Implement permit-to-work audits, lock-out/tag-out spot checks and consequence management.
